'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Peter Grouty LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Peter Grouty]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
